            ,sum(case when t.is_new_open_store_eff='Y' and t.is_valid_store='Y' then t.sale_amt else 0 end)         as bq_new_store_valid_sale_amt             --本期新店有效销售金额
            ,sum(case when t.is_new_open_store_eff='Y' and t.is_valid_store='Y' then t.oper_area else 0 end)        as bq_new_store_valid_area                 --本期新店有效面积
            ,sum(case when t.yyyymm=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表_结束年月] and t.is_new_open_store_eff='Y' then t.oper_area else 0 end) as bq_new_store_oper_area                  --本期新店营业面积
    --改造店指标
            ,case when t.is_rebuild_store_eff='Y' and t.is_valid_store='Y' then count(distinct t.yyyymm) else 0 end as bq_rebuild_store_valid_mon_qty           --本期改造店有效月份数

			,sum(case when t1.beg_yyyymm is not null and t.yyyymm<t1.rebuild_beg_mon then t.sale_amt

			,sum(case when t1.beg_yyyymm is not null and t.yyyymm<t1.rebuild_beg_mon then t.sale_tag_amt

            ,sum(case when t1.beg_yyyymm is not null and t.yyyymm>t1.end_yyyymm then t.sale_amt

			          else 0 end)                as bq_rebuild_store_after_sale_amt          --本期改造店后销售金额
            ,sum(case when t1.end_yyyymm is not null and t.yyyymm>t1.end_yyyymm then t.sale_tag_amt 
			          when t1.beg_yyyymm is not null and t.yyyymm>t1.rebuild_end_mon and t.yyyymm<t1.end_yyyymm then t.sale_tag_amt

            ,sum(case when t.is_rebuild_store_eff='Y' and t.is_valid_store='Y' then t.sale_amt else 0 end)               as bq_rebuild_store_valid_sale_amt          --本期改造店有效销售金额
            ,sum(case when t.is_rebuild_store_eff='Y' and t.is_valid_store='Y' then t.oper_area else 0 end)              as bq_rebuild_store_valid_area              --本期改造店有效面积

			,0 as tq_holding_store_sale_tag_amt

            ,0 as bq_holding_store_oper_area

            ,0 as bq_new_store_oper_area

            ,0 as bq_rebuild_store_front_sale_amt
            ,0 as bq_rebuild_store_front_sale_tag_amt
            ,0 as bq_rebuild_store_after_sale_amt
            ,0 as bq_rebuild_store_after_sale_tag_amt
            ,0 as bq_rebuild_store_valid_sale_amt
            ,0 as bq_rebuild_store_valid_area
            ,0 as bq_rebuild_store_oper_area
            ,0 as bq_rebuild_store_same_sale_amt

			,0 as bq_close_store_sale_tag_amt

            ,case when t.is_valid_store='Y' then t.oper_area else 0 end as tq_valid_oper_area               --同期有效营业面积

            ,sum(case when t.is_rebuild_store_eff='Y' and t.is_valid_store='Y' then t.oper_area else 0 end)               as tq_rebuild_store_valid_area          --同期改造店有效面积
            ,sum(case when t.yyyymm=substr(toString(addYears(toDate(concat([DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表_结束年月],'-01')), -1)),1,7) and t.is_new_open_store_qty='Y' then t.oper_area else 0 end)                       as tq_rebuild_store_oper_area           --同期改造店营业面积
